label: Terminal Fun
notes: The only rail whose model reference may legitimately be a size-scoped GLOB (e.g. gemma4*:12b) rather than an @role or a concrete name, which is why its modelstate copy resolves globs locally with fnmatch.
Ships its CSS as a template literal inside module.tsx rather than a theme.css file, so the theming rules are checked against that string.
Sandboxed: PTY sessions run inside this rail's own container with no host access. The high-privilege host terminal is the separate workstation rail.
